## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and relevant tradeoffs. Link
the issue if applicable. State any compatibility or state-format changes.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Distinguish synthetic/offline checks from any
separately authorized live validation. For packaging changes, attach artifact
hashes and the wheel/sdist installation smoke result.

- [ ] Input examples and logs are synthetic/sanitized; no credentials, private state or real report output.
- [ ] Relevant regression checks pass; documentation and unreleased changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] No automatic replay of unknown external effects or new implicit permission was introduced.
